source: the model header (Trace conformance) and its SigmaObs/H definitions
hidden: H = diff(Events, SigmaObs): a_begin, a_now, a_clr, a_enc, a_disc, stale, p_off, bound, late, idle

renaming.csp: [[ a_sel.g.e.b <- asel.g | g <- GS, e <- TT, b <- Bool ]]
renaming.why: a_sel.g.e.b: e (elapsed ticks at the selection) and b (valid) are not recorded

projection: one Alternative object: its AltGuard events (index 0 starts a new object, possibly at a reused address), the AltDeadline/WaitAlt/Resume/ResumeTimeout of its thread naming it, its AltSelected, and the transfer of the selected channel guard

configurations.name: SYS
requires: exactly one select() (the model is one select())
at most one channel guard (input or output, rendezvous or buffered): the model reduces it to GC, a partner that offers once
every timeout guard 0..3 ticks (the model's delays; tick counter modulo 8)

parameters.gl: the guard list in guard-index order: a channel guard -> GC, a timeout guard of d ticks -> d
parameters.p: trace check: 1 if there is a channel guard (offers once, at any time or never), else 0; stable-failure check: 0 if the prefix has no a_take (the partner did not offer; PARTNER(1)'s pending offer is a hidden event, so that configuration cannot be stable)

events.trace: WaitAlt without AltDeadline (no timeout guard enabled)
the selected channel guard's transfer by the ALT's thread in the select's window: RendezvousDone naming it, BufferedGet (input guard), BufferedPut (output guard)

ticks: tick is observed only in selects with a timeout guard (the only waits that record tick counts); otherwise it is hidden for the trace check
before the first wait: dmin - r ticks (dmin: the shortest timeout guard, all guards being enabled when the select waits; r: the first wait's time left)
during a wait: (resume tick - now) ticks, at most r of them before a_wake, the rest after it
between a resume and the next wait: (next now - resume tick) ticks
after the last resume: none recorded, none placed

stable_failures.offers: the open WaitAlt of this select at the stable point
stable_failures.awaited_environment: tick, if the stable point's offers include an enabled timeout guard of this thread
stable_failures.X: SigmaObs of the projection minus the awaited environment events; tick in a select without timeout guards is blocked by the environment after the marker but not part of X
stable_failures.prefix: the projection's events up to and including the a_block of the open wait; ticks between the wait's start and the stable point are not recorded and not placed

gaps: the select's start tick is not recorded: e in a_sel.g.e.b and late cannot be checked
AltSelected does not name its Alternative: a select() that neither waits nor is the object's first is attributed to the thread's current Alternative
a select that does not wait records only AltGuard (first select) and AltSelected
